tagline: Change one piece of a memory file
description: Replace one exact piece of text in a memory file. `find` must appear exactly once.

inputs.name: find
inputs.description: Text to replace, exactly as it appears.

inputs.name: replace
inputs.description: What to put in its place. Empty removes it.

outputs.name: saved
outputs.description: "saved", or "waiting for approval" when changes need a person to approve them.
